WITH trans_avgs AS (
  SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) as trans_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE anlycount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY transref
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(trans_avg) as overall_avg_val
  FROM trans_avgs
),
filtered_trans AS (
  SELECT ta.transref, ta.trans_avg
  FROM trans_avgs ta, overall_avg oa
  WHERE ta.trans_avg > oa.overall_avg_val
),
kept_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(trans_avg) as kept_avg_val
  FROM filtered_trans
)
SELECT 
  ft.transref,
  ft.trans_avg,
  ft.trans_avg - oa.overall_avg_val as above_overall,
  ft.trans_avg - ka.kept_avg_val as above_kept
FROM filtered_trans ft, overall_avg oa, kept_avg ka
ORDER BY above_kept DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
